description: Group webhook deliveries by identity within a time window and decide: process, dedupe, retry, reconcile or abstain — Given previously seen deliveries (identity, receivedAt, payload or digest, handling outcome) and a new incoming one, finds earlier deliveries with the same identity inside the window and returns process (none), dedupe (same payload already processed), retry (earlier ones all failed), reconcile (an earlier one is in flight or unknown, or the same identity arrives with a different payload) or abstai

identity.description: Delivery identity: the provider's event id, or a key built from the fields that define the event.

outcome.description: What happened when this delivery was handled (history only).

payload.description: Event body; hashed with RFC 8785 canonical JSON to detect conflicting duplicates.

payloadDigest.description: Alternative to payload: a digest the caller computed.
